DIA-NN — system-library notices

DIA-NN uses libraries supplied by the operating system and its installed desktop
and graphics components. Their copyright notices and license information are
collected separately here; the system-library binaries are not included in the
portable DIA-NN UI package.

linux/README.txt
    Component/version index and copyright notices for Linux system libraries,
    including their indirect dependencies and the listed desktop/graphics modules.

license-texts/
    Full license texts referenced by the Linux notices, including the GNU Lesser
    General Public License and the GNU General Public License. Component notices
    identify applicable alternatives and exceptions, including the GCC Runtime
    Library Exception. The presence of a license text does not apply that license
    to DIA-NN or to every component in this directory.

windows/README.txt
    Notices for Microsoft Windows system components, including the Universal C
    Runtime used by DuckDB.

LGPL-covered system libraries are used through shared-library interfaces and
remain replaceable by compatible modified versions. Their respective licenses
govern the libraries and the rights associated with their use.

Notices for the DuckDB and FreeType libraries supplied with DIA-NN are in the
parent directory: DuckDB-ThirdParty.txt and FreeType.txt, with the additional
notice files identified by the parent README.txt.
